indicator_name: Money expenditure of the bottom and top income decile, by item
description: Денежные расходы домашних хозяйств 10% наименее и 10% наиболее обеспеченного населения, по статьям
unit: KZT per month per 100 household members
methodology: Taldau 704518, annual 2001-2024 (food from 2004). Items D01_* / D10_*: money and consumer expenditure, food, eating out, non-food, services, transfers to other households, taxes, debt repayment. The middle deciles are published for 2024 only and are not taken. 2024 equals the annual edition's table 10.
